    Restrictions of unit forms and critical restrictions #

    The restriction of a unit form to a finite set s of indices (UnitForm.restrict) computes the form on vectors supported in s (val_restrict). A form that is not weakly positive has a critical restriction: one to a set of minimal size on which it is not weakly positive (exists_critical_restrict).
